# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

**Top pick: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, about $120 with a code**
- It lists at $149.99, and Dealectric says code AFSC20 brings it to $120. They tested that in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, and the code expires 2026-12-31. It doesn't work on items already on sale. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150-2026-reviews-prices))
- It has adaptive ANC with 7 sensors, LDAC for Android, and Bluetooth 5.3 with multipoint. Battery is 7.5 hours per charge, or 30 hours with the case, with ANC on.
- iTech Level says it's often discounted to around $100 and cites SoundGuys testing in which its ANC beat 63% of earbuds. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))
- Caveats: the newer Liberty 5 Pro costs $169.99, and sources disagree on water resistance (IPX5 vs. IP55).
- **Buy:** [Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Other good options**
- **Sony WF-C710N (best budget):** What Hi-Fi? lists it at about $119 at Walmart and $128 at Best Buy, with controlled bass. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)
- **Nothing Ear (3):** iTech Level calls it the strongest ANC under $150 on any phone, citing SoundGuys' 8.2/10 ANC score. It has LDAC and wireless charging. I didn't see its price in the excerpt, so check it before buying. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)
- **EarFun Air Pro 4:** Sound Mavericks ranks it #1, with claimed 50dB adaptive ANC, LDAC and wireless charging. That ranking is based on spec sheets and others' measurements, not hands-on testing, and the excerpt doesn't show a price. [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)
- **For iPhone:** AirPods 5 cost $129, or $149 with the wireless charging case. They have an open fit, so isolation will be weaker than with in-ear tips. A renewed AirPods Pro 2 can run just under $150 on sale, and SlashGear praises its ANC. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- **For Android/Pixel:** Google Pixel Buds 2a cost $129. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)
- **Cheapest:** Tom's Guide picks the CMF by Nothing Buds 2A as its budget choice. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/earbuds/best-noise-canceling-earbuds)

Skip the Soundcore AeroFit 2. It's open-ear with no ANC.

For the quietest ride at the lowest price, get the Liberty 4 Pro. iPhone users who prefer Apple's ecosystem should look at the AirPods 5 or a renewed AirPods Pro 2. Prices change often, so confirm the final price at checkout.
